description.en: Hemalurgy, the Scadrial art of impaling and moving attributes via spikes, is the technique the Prophet employed on Miral: a silver stake hammered into the Megalith to restrain it.
description.es: La hemalurgia, arte scadriano que consiste en clavar púas y traspasar atributos, constituye la técnica que empleó el Profeta en Miral: una púa de plata hincada en el Megalito para retenerlo.

sources.cites: The Fires of December, chapter 26 (Miral section)
The Fires of December, chapter XXVI

description.en: To make the binding possible, the Aon on the spike was affixed using a cushion of cleansed Breaths, an altered variety of BioChromatic Breath, which is the Investiture native to Nalthis.
description.es: Para que la atadura fuese viable, el aon del clavo se sujetó mediante una base de alientos depurados, variedad alterada del aliento biocromático, que es la Investidura propia de Nalthis.

sources.cites: The Fires of December, chapters XXV and XXXVIII
The Fires of December, chapter 38 (Miral section)

description.en: The bond on the spike relies on an Aon, namely Aon Reo; Aons constitute a script used on Sel.
description.es: El vínculo del clavo emplea un aon, concretamente el aon Reo; los aones constituyen un tipo de escritura propio de Sel.

sources.cites: The Fires of December, chapter XXV

description.en: A portion of the Evil from Threnody arrived on Miral, where such beings go by the name demons; they are Splinters of Ambition.
description.es: Una porción de la Maldad de Treno alcanzó Miral, lugar donde a esas entidades se las llama demonios; son Astillas de Ambición.

sources.cites: Isles of the Emberdark, chapter 39; The Fires of December, chapters IV and XXIV
The Fires of December, chapter IV

description.en: Valor, the Shard, operated on Miral, and Hoid travels there in pursuit of Valor; the Stormlight Archive lays the groundwork for that quest and offers additional details about this Shard.
description.es: En Miral tuvo actividad la Esquirla Valentía, y Hoid acude a ese mundo tras la pista de Valentía; El Archivo de las Tormentas sienta las bases de esa pesquisa y amplía datos sobre esta Esquirla.

sources.cites: The Fires of December, chapter IV and epilogue; Rhythm of War, chapter 25 epigraph; Wind and Truth, chapter 115 and epilogue
The Fires of December, chapters IV and XXIV, and epilogue

description.en: Hoid's visit to Miral belongs to the hunt for Valor, which he embarks upon once he finishes assisting Waxillium.
description.es: La visita de Hoid a Miral se inscribe en la persecución de Valentía que inicia después de prestar auxilio a Waxillium.

sources.cites: The Fires of December, epilogue; Wind and Truth, epilogue

description.en: Hoid shows up in this volume, visiting Miral.
description.es: Hoid comparece en este volumen, de visita en Miral.

sources.cites: The Fires of December, epilogue (Hoid visits the planet)
The Fires of December, chapters IV, XII and the epilogue
